text:
nina: FYI starting staged rollout v3.5.0 canary (5%) in ap-south-1 in ~2m. Change window 03:00-04:00 UTC. Preflight green but please watch tokenization and tail latency.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight checks PASS. Canary allocation created (5% traffic).

samir: telemetry https://metrics.internal/redwood/canary/18499 p95 +25% vs baseline, taily. No 5xx.

olga: running a quick diff  looks like tokenizer change in v3.5.0 splits URLs/emojis into more tokens. some requests jumped from ~700 tokens to ~1100 tokens, which could explain the latency.

sre-oncall: infra view: mem stable, kvcache evictions slightly up on canary pods, CPU a bit higher, but no errors. Evict rate ~1.8x since rollout.

paul: options: 1) hold and pin canary to v3.4.9-legacy-tokenizer, 2) rollback canary to v3.4.9, 3) continue and risk wider tail. I vote hold+pin.

nina: agree. Pause percent bumps and pin to legacy tokenizer while ML fixes tokenizer heuristics.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: pausing automated percent increases per request.

paul: Pinning canary allocation canary-ap-south-1-2 -> v3.4.9-legacy-tokenizer now...

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary pinned to v3.4.9-legacy-tokenizer (allocation: canary-ap-south-1-2). Audit: deploy-audit/1849999999-pin.

sre-oncall: early snapshot: token counts on pinned canary back to baseline and p95 trending down. Will attach 10m snapshot to ticket.

samir: sample log showing token jump with v3.5.0 tokenizer:```
[03:05:12] model: req=id=tx77 orig_len=842 new_tokens=1124 latency=612ms
[03:05:12] tokenizer: split url=https://x.example into tokens=18 (prev=6)
[03:05:13] model: req=id=tx77 served_on=canary-3
```

olga: Adding release notes line: "ap-south-1 canary temporarily pinned to v3.4.9-legacy-tokenizer due to increased token counts and tail latency observed with v3.5.0 tokenizer; ML team investigating tokenization heuristics." Any objections?

nina: No objections. I'll update RN and open INV-2109 for the tokenizer fix. Also update rollback playbook with pin/unpin steps.

paul: I'll own unpin when ML signals fixes. For now keep pinned and reconvene in 10m to decide next step.

sre-oncall: If latency resurfaces we escalate to rollback. For now metrics look good post-pin.

nina: Thanks everyone. Holding at 5% pinned. Reopen thread for reconvene. :slightly_smiling_face:
